When Margot, an unemployed film critic, discovers a poster for a clandestine film festival, she embarks on a journey that challenges everything she believes about memory, cinema, and what it means for a film to survive.

1735961.title: The Phantom
1735961.overview: Two female producers are commissioned to create a short documentary for an exhibition dedicated to Rubén Santantonín, an elusive figure of the Argentine avant-garde who died very young, in the late 1960s. However, the client imposes one unexpected condition: the video must be made together with David Lamelas, Santantonín’s former collaborator and today an internationally recognized figure of conceptual art. At first, the plan seems clear and limited in scope: Lamelas, accompanied by a young film crew, gathers archival materials, documents the few surviving works, and interviews curators and major artists – such as Luis Felipe Noé and Marta Minujín – who, along with Santantonín and Lamelas, peopled the legendary scene at the Instituto Torcuato Di Tella. Lamelas gradually realizes that reconstructing the story of his friend also means confronting a series of gaps and contradictions.

1746649.title: LAGUM Ao Vivo na Amazônia
1746649.overview: LAGUM Ao Vivo na Amazônia is part of Lagum’s 2026 plans, following LAGUM Ao Vivo no Bondinho (RJ). The band brings its music to the heart of the Amazon for a special live performance surrounded by the beauty of the rainforest. The project celebrates music, nature, and Brazilian culture, while supporting the conservation of the Amazon. All CO₂ emissions from the production were compensated through the REDD+ Jutaítuba Project.

1749209.title: Madness
1749209.overview: A young couple is trapped under financial strain and domestic dread. Driven by despair and haunted by the dark past of their relationship, they begin to lose their sanity, spiraling into disturbing and unnatural acts. Tension reaches a breaking point when he notices blood running down his wife's thigh. Panicked by the sound of a baby crying that suddenly shifts from place to place, he rushes into the bedroom to seek help. Inside, however, all he finds are broken child mannequins. Before he can escape, his wife slams the door shut and locks him inside, completely alone.
